listen_addr.description: IP address or hostname to bind the SOCKS5 proxy server to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port for incoming SOCKS5 connections (standard port is 1080).

workers.description: Number of worker threads; 0 means auto-scale based on CPU cores.

daemonize.description: Whether to run as a background (daemon) process.

pidfile.description: Path to write the process PID file when daemonizing. Must be writable by the service user.

logstream.description: Where to send logs: 'stderr', 'syslog', or a file path (e.g., /var/log/microsocks.log).

auth_users.description: List of 'username:password' entries for authentication (required if auth_enabled=true).

timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Connections held open longer than this are closed.

maxconn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections. 0 means unlimited.

allow_ipv4.description: Whether to allow IPv4 connections and DNS resolution.

allow_ipv6.description: Whether to allow IPv6 connections and DNS resolution.

bind_out.description: IP address to bind outgoing (target) connections to. Leave empty to let the OS choose automatically.

chroot.description: Chroot directory after startup (e.g., /var/lib/microsocks). Leave empty for no chroot.

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup (must exist).

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup (must exist).
